_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_AllowMovementTT: Your character can walk while the menu is open, and the camera follows them.\n[Skyrim Souls only, as the menus pause the game otherwise.]
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_AnimateTT: Keeps your character's idle animation playing. Off, they hold still.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_BarterMenuTT: Shows your character in the barter menu.\n[May conflict with Conversational camera-type mods.]
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_CameraControlsTT: Move the camera with the mouse and controller. Off, only the sliders under Position move it. Turning your character works either way.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_ContainerMenuTT: Shows your character while looting chests and other containers.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_EnableTT: Toggles Show Player In Inventory ON and OFF.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_HideItemPreviewsTT: Hides the 3D model of the selected item while your character is shown, so it doesn't cover them.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_MagicMenuTT: Shows your character in the magic menu.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_RememberCameraTT: Opens the menu with the camera where you left it last time. Off, it starts from the default view each time.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_ResetCameraTT: Puts the camera back where it starts. Works while a menu showing your character is open.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_SlidersClosed: The position sliders work while a menu showing your character is open.
line:menu_translation/showplayerininvent.$SPII_TurnCharacterTT: Your character turns to face the camera where it is. Off, the camera comes round to face your character instead, so they stay as they are.\n[Barter and chests always turn your character, to mitigate view obstruction.]
